answers.text/5601: Looks like your vampire blood saved you this time.
answers.text/5602: I never thought it would come to this...
answers.text/5605: You've lost some of your memory, it seems...
answers.text/5607: We fought the Immortals together. You haven't forgotten me, too?
answers.text/5608: I'm Otenko, messenger of the Sun.
answers.text/5610: First, we have to get out of this dungeon.
answers.text/5613: <PROC=1>The LIFE gauge at the top left shows your health.
answers.text/5614: When an enemy hurts you, your LIFE drops.
answers.text/5615: If it reaches zero, it's game over.
answers.text/5616: The ENE gauge below LIFE shows your spirit energy.
answers.text/5617: Your weapon, the Gun Del Sol, runs on magic...
answers.text/5619: We'll have to find somewhere to recharge...
answers.text/1043: A green potion. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1046: Slow-dried monster meat. Restores some LIFE.
answers.text/1047: Roast monster meat. Restores a lot of LIFE.
answers.text/1049: A sweet treat. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1051: Melted chocolate. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1052: Something coated in chocolate. What could be inside?
answers.text/1053: A soda ice pop. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1054: A cola ice pop. Restores a little LIFE.
answers.text/1055: A red potion. Restores a little ENE.
answers.text/1057: A poisonous mushroom. Restores ENE, but...
answers.text/1058: A blue potion that cures poison.
answers.text/1059: A yellow potion that cures poison and confusion.
answers.text/1060: Water purified by sunlight. Lifts Karmos's curse.
answers.text/1061: Sun-grown fruit. Helps you endure damage.
answers.text/1062: Sun-grown fruit. Makes you run faster.
answers.text/1064: A chocolate-coated banana. Carry things faster.
answers.text/1069: A leaf from the Solar Tree. Warps you outside the dungeon.
answers.text/1070: An old charm doll that drives away clouds.
answers.text/1071: An old charm doll that calls in clouds.
answers.text/1072: Old sandals for predicting the weather.
answers.text/1073: A stick that has served its purpose.
answers.text/1074: A stick stamped with a free ice pop. Give it to Gari-Gari Kun!
answers.text/1075: A card of wisdom. Raises Spirit.
answers.text/1076: A card of motherhood. Raises Body.
answers.text/1077: A card of courage. Raises Strength.
answers.text/1078: A card of destiny. Raises one stat.
answers.text/1079: A card of unease. Fully restores LIFE.
answers.text/1080: A card of happiness. Fully restores ENE.
